pages.text: The Akaishi Ingot is the core material for mid- and late-game machines and equipment.$(br2)$(bold)Production:$(reset) 10M Akaishi Energy and 1 Netherite Ingot fed into the $(l:akaishi:aggregator)Energy Aggregator$(/l) condense into 1 ingot.$(br2)No furnace recipe exists; mass production requires 10M-scale energy storage. Ancient Debris should be retained, as it is the required ingredient.

The ingot is the primary upstream material: upgrade templates, reactor fuel rods and shells, the fuel canner, and fusion and wireless components all require it, as does $(l:akaishi:equipment)Equipment$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)Allocation:$(reset) reserve ingots for the Equipment Forger and upgrade templates first. If the grid can supply it, leave the Aggregator running and stockpile ingots.
Chain: crystals → blocks → essence (see Crystal & Essence) → 10M-scale energy storage → the Aggregator condenses ingots → the ingots are consumed by the Equipment Forger.
